<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=240,initial-scale=1">
<title>At the writing desk</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:242px;overflow:hidden;background:#cac0b2}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:242px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';

const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,242,false);
renderer.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.shadowMap.enabled=true;
renderer.shadowMap.type=THREE.PCFShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene=new THREE.Scene();
scene.background=new THREE.Color(0xcac0b2);
const V=(x=0,y=0,z=0)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
const C=c=>new THREE.Color(c);
const tau=2*Math.PI;
const tilt=17*Math.PI/180,sn=Math.sin(tilt),cs=Math.cos(tilt);
const view=V(0,sn,cs);
const W=(u,v,z)=>V(u-120,(185-v+sn*z)/cs,z);
const delta=(du,dv,dz=0)=>V(du,(-dv+sn*dz)/cs,dz);
const tablePoint=(u,v,h)=>V(u-120,h,(v-185+cs*h)/sn);
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-120,120,121,-121,.1,1600);
const focus=V(0,(185-121)/cs,0);
ref.position.copy(focus).addScaledVector(view,680);
ref.lookAt(focus);
ref.updateProjectionMatrix();

const clamp=(x,a=0,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));
function smooth(a,b,x){
  const q=clamp((x-a)/(b-a));
  return q*q*(3-2*q);
}
let seed=72393;
function random(){
  seed=(Math.imul(1664525,seed)+1013904223)>>>0;
  return seed/4294967296;
}
function texture(fn,color=false){
  const data=new Uint8Array(64*64*4);
  for(let y=0;y<64;y++)for(let x=0;x<64;x++){
    const p=fn(x,y);
    for(let k=0;k<4;k++)data[(64*y+x)*4+k]=Math.round(clamp(p[k],0,255));
  }
  const t=new THREE.DataTexture(data,64,64,THREE.RGBAFormat);
  t.wrapS=t.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  t.magFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;
  t.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
  t.generateMipmaps=true;
  if(color)t.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  t.needsUpdate=true;
  return t;
}
const nap=texture((x,y)=>{
  const n=124+82*(random()-.5)+15*Math.sin(tau*(3*x+6*y)/64);
  return [n,n,n,255];
});
nap.repeat.set(8,5);
const woodGrain=texture((x,y)=>{
  const phase=y+1.12*Math.sin(tau*x/64)+.53*Math.cos(tau*(2*x+y)/64);
  const n=240+4.5*Math.sin(tau*phase*7/64)+5.4*Math.cos(tau*phase*17/64)
    -12*Math.pow(.5+.5*Math.cos(tau*phase*3/64),12)+3*(random()-.5);
  return [n+4,n,n-4,255];
},true);
const contact=texture((x,y)=>{
  const r=Math.hypot((x-31.5)/31.5,(y-31.5)/31.5);
  return [255,255,255,255*Math.pow(Math.max(0,1-r*r),2.8)];
});
contact.wrapS=contact.wrapT=THREE.ClampToEdgeWrapping;
function material(color,opt={}){
  const m=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness:.88,...opt});
  m.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
    shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <dithering_fragment>',`
      #include <dithering_fragment>
      float grain = fract(52.9829189 * fract(dot(gl_FragCoord.xy, vec2(0.06711056,0.00583715))));
      gl_FragColor.rgb += (grain-0.5)*0.019;
    `);
  };
  return m;
}
const gold=material(0xf3b427,{bumpMap:nap,bumpScale:.15});
const cream=material(0xf2dfbc,{bumpMap:nap,bumpScale:.12});
const paw=material(0x716354,{bumpMap:nap,bumpScale:.16,roughness:.96});
const paper=material(0xfff6df,{side:THREE.DoubleSide});
const sphere=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,30);
function local(parent,world){
  parent.updateWorldMatrix(true,false);
  return parent.worldToLocal(world.clone());
}
function group(parent,name,world){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  if(world)g.position.copy(local(parent,world));
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
function mesh(parent,name,geo,mat,cast=true){
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo,mat);
  m.name=name;
  m.castShadow=cast;
  m.receiveShadow=true;
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}
function ellipsoid(parent,name,p,r,mat,rot){
  const m=mesh(parent,name,sphere,mat);
  m.position.copy(local(parent,p));
  m.scale.set(...r);
  if(rot)m.rotation.set(...rot);
  return m;
}
function cub(a,b,c,d,t){
  return b+.5*t*(c-a+t*(2*a-5*b+4*c-d+t*(3*b-a-3*c+d)));
}
function sample(rows,s){
  const f=clamp(s)*(rows.length-1),i=Math.min(rows.length-2,Math.floor(f)),t=f-i;
  const b=rows[i],c=rows[i+1];
  return b.map((v,k)=>cub(i?rows[i-1][k]:2*v-c[k],v,c[k],
    i+2<rows.length?rows[i+2][k]:2*c[k]-v,t));
}
function buffer(pos,idx,uv,norm,col){
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  g.setIndex(idx);
  if(uv)g.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
  if(norm)g.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(norm,3));
  else g.computeVertexNormals();
  if(col)g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col,3));
  return g;
}
function seamNormals(g,steps,sides){
  const n=g.attributes.normal;
  for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
    const a=i*(sides+1),b=a+sides;
    const v=V(n.getX(a)+n.getX(b),n.getY(a)+n.getY(b),n.getZ(a)+n.getZ(b)).normalize();
    n.setXYZ(a,v.x,v.y,v.z);
    n.setXYZ(b,v.x,v.y,v.z);
  }
  n.needsUpdate=true;
}
function sweep(parent,name,rows,mat){
  const centers=rows.map(r=>local(parent,W(r[0],r[1],r[2])));
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(centers,false,'centripetal');
  const widths=rows.map(r=>[r[3],r[4]??r[3]]);
  const steps=(rows.length-1)*7,sides=28;
  const pos=[],ind=[],uv=[];
  let previous;
  for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
    const t=i/steps,p=path.getPoint(t),along=path.getTangent(t).normalize();
    const side=V().crossVectors(view,along);
    if(side.lengthSq()<.0001)side.copy(previous||V(1,0,0));
    side.normalize();
    if(previous&&previous.dot(side)<0)side.negate();
    previous=side.clone();
    const deep=V().crossVectors(along,side).normalize(),[r,d]=sample(widths,t);
    for(let j=0;j<=sides;j++){
      const a=tau*j/sides;
      const pt=p.clone().addScaledVector(side,Math.max(.018,r)*Math.cos(a))
        .addScaledVector(deep,Math.max(.018,d)*Math.sin(a));
      pos.push(pt.x,pt.y,pt.z);
      uv.push(j/sides,t);
      if(i<steps&&j<sides){
        const k=i*(sides+1)+j;
        ind.push(k,k+1,k+sides+1,k+1,k+sides+2,k+sides+1);
      }
    }
  }
  const g=buffer(pos,ind,uv);
  seamNormals(g,steps,sides);
  const m=mesh(parent,name,g,mat);
  m.userData.steps=steps;
  m.userData.sides=sides;
  return m;
}

const leftProfile=[
  [52.3,64.8,1,0,0],[52.55,64.6,1,5.5,4.8],[54.5,64.1,1.1,13.4,11.5],
  [59.6,62.9,1.5,21.1,18.5],[69,61.1,1.3,28.1,24.3],[82.8,59.3,.6,33.4,28.5],
  [97,56.6,-1.8,38.3,32.6],[113.5,53.1,-5,42.6,35.8],[132,50.5,-9,46.9,38.2],
  [151,48.6,-14.4,50.2,40.5],[169,47.7,-19.5,51.2,41.1],[182.5,47.8,-23.2,50.5,40.4],
  [191,48.2,-25.5,44.7,35.8],[196.3,49,-26.7,31.2,24.6],[198.5,49.5,-26.8,16.3,13.2],[199.1,49.5,-26.8,0,0]
];
const rightProfile=[
  [42.5,146.2,-37,0,0],[42.8,146.2,-37,5.8,4.9],[44.6,146.5,-37,12.7,10.5],
  [49.5,147.4,-37.4,19.6,16.8],[58.4,149,-38,25.4,22.6],[71.4,151.7,-39.5,30.9,27.4],
  [86.3,157,-42.4,35.7,32.2],[103,163,-46,40.1,36],[120,169.1,-50.2,44.3,38.7],
  [138.5,175,-54.6,47.7,41],[156.2,180,-58.5,50.4,42.6],[171.4,183.3,-61.4,52.8,43.6],
  [182.5,185,-62.5,53.1,42.9],[189.4,185.8,-62.9,46.6,37],[194,186.6,-63,32.3,25.8],
  [196.1,186.8,-63,15.7,12.5],[196.6,186.8,-63,0,0]
];
function character(name,rows,isLeft){
  const foot=rows[11],neck=rows[7];
  const root=group(scene,name,W(foot[1],foot[0],foot[2]));
  const body=group(root,'body');
  const head=group(body,'head',W(neck[1],neck[0],neck[2]));
  const headRest=head.position.clone();
  const pivot=root.getWorldPosition(V());
  const pos=[],norm=[],idx=[],uv=[],col=[];
  const morph=[[],[],[]];
  const vertical=100,around=128;
  const base=C(isLeft?0xf0af24:0xf6bb31),bib=C(isLeft?0xf2dcb8:0xf5e2bc);
  function shapeWeights(v){
    return [1-smooth(89,184,v),1-smooth(132,200,v),
      smooth(100,138,v)*(1-smooth(150,197,v))];
  }
  function ring(s,a){
    const [v,x,z,r,d]=sample(rows,s);
    const organic=1+.0025*Math.sin(3*a+3*s)+.0018*Math.cos(5*a-6*s);
    return W(x+Math.sin(a)*r*organic,v,z).add(V(0,0,Math.cos(a)*d*organic));
  }
  for(let i=0;i<=vertical;i++){
    const s=i/vertical,[line]=sample(rows,s),[wx,wy,wb]=shapeWeights(line);
    for(let j=0;j<=around;j++){
      const a=tau*j/around,p=ring(s,a),rel=p.clone().sub(pivot);
      pos.push(rel.x,rel.y,rel.z);
      morph[0].push(10*wx,0,0);
      morph[1].push(0,-20*wy/cs,0);
      morph[2].push(0,-6*wb/cs,0);
      const down=ring(clamp(s+.00018),a).sub(ring(clamp(s-.00018),a));
      const across=ring(s,a+.001).sub(ring(s,a-.001));
      const n=i===0?V(0,1,0):i===vertical?V(0,-1,0):down.cross(across).normalize();
      norm.push(n.x,n.y,n.z);
      uv.push(j/around,1-s);
      const bellyAngle=isLeft?.20:-.27;
      const angle=Math.atan2(Math.sin(a-bellyAngle),Math.cos(a-bellyAngle));
      const edge=(angle/(isLeft?1.22:1.29))**2+((line-(isLeft?185:186))/(isLeft?52:49))**2;
      const bibMix=1-smooth(.94,1.055,edge+.017*Math.sin(5*a+7*s));
      const v=185-cs*p.y+sn*p.z,u=p.x+120;
      let occlusion=1;
      if(isLeft){
        occlusion-=.13*Math.exp(-((u-97)**2/190+(v-173)**2/140))*Math.max(0,Math.cos(a));
        occlusion-=.13*Math.exp(-((u-14)**2/185+(v-165)**2/640))*Math.max(0,Math.cos(a));
      }else{
        occlusion-=.21*Math.exp(-((u-169)**2/980+(v-160)**2/185))*Math.max(0,Math.cos(a));
      }
      const shade=(.992+.009*Math.sin(4*a+7*s)*Math.sin(3*a-13*s))*
        (1-.115*smooth(171,200,line))*occlusion;
      const color=base.clone().lerp(bib,bibMix).multiplyScalar(shade);
      col.push(color.r,color.g,color.b);
      if(i<vertical&&j<around){
        const k=i*(around+1)+j;
        idx.push(k,k+around+1,k+1,k+1,k+around+1,k+around+2);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=buffer(pos,idx,uv,norm,col);
  geo.morphTargetsRelative=true;
  geo.morphAttributes.position=morph.map(a=>new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(a,3));
  const coat=mesh(body,'continuous-felt-body-and-head',geo,
    material(0xffffff,{vertexColors:true,bumpMap:nap,bumpScale:.14}));
  let dx=0,dy=0,belly=0;
  function pose(x,y,b){
    dx=x;dy=y;belly=b;
    const m=coat.morphTargetInfluences;
    m[0]=x/10;m[1]=y/20;m[2]=b/6;
    head.position.copy(headRest).add(delta(x,y));
    head.updateWorldMatrix(true,false);
  }
  function surfacePoint(u,v,angle=null){
    let lo=0,hi=.875,depth=0,x=u;
    for(let k=0;k<21;k++){
      const [line,cx,z,r,d]=sample(rows,(lo+hi)/2);
      const [wx,wy,wb]=shapeWeights(line),center=cx+dx*wx;
      const sa=angle===null?clamp((u-center)/Math.max(r,.001),-1,1):Math.sin(angle);
      const co=angle===null?Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-sa*sa)):Math.cos(angle);
      x=center+sa*r;
      depth=z+d*co;
      const projected=line+dy*wy+belly*wb+sn*d*co;
      if(projected<v)lo=(lo+hi)/2;else hi=(lo+hi)/2;
    }
    return W(x,v,depth);
  }
  return {root,body,head,pose,surface:surfacePoint};
}
const left=character('character-left-writing',leftProfile,true);
const right=character('character-right-reaching',rightProfile,false);

const eyeRim=material(0xc29140);
const sclera=material(0x9d8f79,{roughness:.55});
const irisMat=material(0xffffff,{vertexColors:true,roughness:.47});
const pupilMat=material(0x181712,{roughness:.39});
const catchMat=material(0xb9ac90,{roughness:.5});
function capGeometry(angle,radius,iris){
  const p=[],idx=[],colors=[],seg=48,bands=12;
  for(let i=0;i<=bands;i++){
    const f=i/bands,ph=f*angle;
    for(let j=0;j<=seg;j++){
      const a=j*tau/seg;
      p.push(radius*Math.sin(ph)*Math.cos(a),radius*Math.sin(ph)*Math.sin(a),radius*Math.cos(ph));
      if(iris){
        const c=C(0x504b3c).lerp(C(0x39372f),smooth(.76,1,f));
        c.multiplyScalar(.95+.095*Math.cos(a*27)+.045*Math.sin(a*19));
        colors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      }
      if(i<bands&&j<seg){
        const k=i*(seg+1)+j;
        idx.push(k,k+seg+1,k+1,k+1,k+seg+1,k+seg+2);
      }
    }
  }
  return buffer(p,idx,null,null,iris?colors:null);
}
const irisGeo=capGeometry(.835,1.006,true),pupilGeo=capGeometry(.565,1.011,false);
function eye(ch,which,radii){
  const e=group(ch.head,which);
  e.rotation.order='YXZ';
  const [rx,ry,rz]=radii;
  const rim=mesh(e,'felt-eye-rim',sphere,eyeRim);
  rim.scale.set(rx*1.09,ry*1.05,rz*.80);
  rim.position.z=-1.35;
  const ball=group(e,'eyeball');
  ball.scale.set(rx,ry,rz);
  mesh(ball,'warm-grey-sclera',sphere,sclera);
  const gaze=group(ball,'gaze');
  mesh(gaze,'umber-iris',irisGeo,irisMat);
  mesh(gaze,'pupil',pupilGeo,pupilMat);
  const dot=mesh(gaze,'soft-catchlight',sphere,catchMat,false);
  dot.position.set(-.20,.29,.956);dot.scale.set(.056,.043,.022);
  return function(u,v,yaw,gx,gy,angle=null){
    e.position.copy(local(ch.head,ch.surface(u,v,angle)));
    e.rotation.y=yaw;e.rotation.x=-.13;
    gaze.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V(0,0,1),V(gx,gy,1).normalize());
  };
}
const leftNear=eye(left,'eye-near',[8.35,8.8,6.45]);
const leftFar=eye(left,'eye-far',[6.55,7.9,5.35]);
const rightFar=eye(right,'eye-far',[5.3,6.65,4.8]);
const rightNear=eye(right,'eye-near',[8.15,8.55,6.25]);

function mouth(ch,name){
  const g=group(ch.head,name);
  const idx=[],col=[],positions=[],lipPositions=[],lipIdx=[];
  const count=36;
  for(let i=0;i<=count;i++){
    const b=Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*i/count),.77);
    for(let j=0;j<4;j++){
      positions.push(0,0,0);
      const c=C(0x312318).lerp(C(0x80531f),.76*(j/3)**2+.19*(1-b));
      col.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      if(i<count&&j<3){
        const k=i*4+j;
        idx.push(k,k+1,k+4,k+1,k+5,k+4);
      }
    }
    lipPositions.push(0,0,0,0,0,0);
    if(i<count){
      const k=i*2;
      lipIdx.push(k,k+1,k+2,k+1,k+3,k+2);
    }
  }
  const geom=buffer(positions,idx,null,null,col),lipGeo=buffer(lipPositions,lipIdx);
  const opening=mesh(g,'mouth-opening',geom,material(0xffffff,{vertexColors:true,side:THREE.DoubleSide}),false);
  const lip=mesh(g,'lower-lip',lipGeo,material(0xe8aa3b,{side:THREE.DoubleSide}),false);
  opening.frustumCulled=false;lip.frustumCulled=false;
  return function(x0,x1,y0,y1,smile,gap){
    const center=ch.surface((x0+x1)/2,(y0+y1)/2+smile);
    g.position.copy(local(ch.head,center));
    for(let i=0;i<=count;i++){
      const a=i/count,b=Math.pow(Math.sin(a*Math.PI),.77);
      const x=x0+(x1-x0)*a,y=y0+(y1-y0)*a+smile*b,thick=gap*b*(1.12-.32*a);
      for(let j=0;j<4;j++){
        const p=ch.surface(x,y+thick*j/3).addScaledVector(view,.46).sub(center);
        geom.attributes.position.setXYZ(i*4+j,p.x,p.y,p.z);
      }
      for(let j=0;j<2;j++){
        const p=ch.surface(x,y+thick+.54*b*j).addScaledVector(view,.39).sub(center);
        lipGeo.attributes.position.setXYZ(i*2+j,p.x,p.y,p.z);
      }
    }
    for(const geo of [geom,lipGeo]){
      geo.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;
      geo.computeVertexNormals();
      geo.computeBoundingSphere();
    }
  };
}
const leftMouth=mouth(left,'expressive-mouth'),rightMouth=mouth(right,'open-smile');

function arm(ch,name,rows){
  const g=group(ch.body,name,W(...rows[0].slice(0,3)));
  const m=sweep(g,'yellow-felt-arm',rows,gold);
  const geo=m.geometry,a=geo.attributes.position,rest=new Float32Array(a.array);
  a.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
  const {steps,sides}=m.userData;
  function bend(shoulder,hand,elbow){
    for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
      const f=i/steps,w=smooth(.12,.94,f),h=Math.sin(Math.PI*f)**2;
      const x=shoulder.x*(1-w)+hand.x*w+elbow.x*h;
      const y=shoulder.y*(1-w)+hand.y*w+elbow.y*h;
      const z=shoulder.z*(1-w)+hand.z*w+elbow.z*h;
      for(let j=0;j<=sides;j++){
        const k=(i*(sides+1)+j)*3;
        a.array[k]=rest[k]+x;a.array[k+1]=rest[k+1]+y;a.array[k+2]=rest[k+2]+z;
      }
    }
    a.needsUpdate=true;
    geo.computeVertexNormals();
    seamNormals(geo,steps,sides);
    geo.computeBoundingSphere();
  }
  return {g,bend};
}
function movingHand(parent,name,p){
  const g=group(parent,name,p),rest=g.position.clone();
  return {g,pose(offset,roll=0){
    g.position.copy(rest).add(offset);
    g.quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(view,roll);
  }};
}
const farRight=arm(right,'arm-far-around-companion',[
  [150,99,-48,.12],[145,101,-44,8.8],[134,107,-35,11.8],[122,113.6,-25,12.3],
  [114,117,-18,10.5],[107.3,114.5,-12,8],[102,111.4,-9,5.3],[100,110,-8,.15]
]);
const farHug=movingHand(farRight.g,'hand-on-shoulder',W(101,110,-9));
ellipsoid(farHug.g,'palm',W(100,110.6,-9),[6.2,5.8,5.1],paw,[.1,0,-.50]);
for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
  sweep(farHug.g,'curled-finger-'+(k+1),[
    [102+k*1.5,110.1+k*.9,-10,.2],[99.7+k*1.5,106.8+k*1.2,-6,2.55],
    [97.3+k*1.6,105.4+k*1.2,-3.4,2.35],[95.3+k*1.8,108.8+k,-2,1.7],
    [95.3+k*1.8,110.1+k,-2,.12]
  ],paw);
}
const resting=arm(left,'arm-far-resting',[
  [83,114,-12,.1],[91.2,123,-6.1,9.5],[101,135,1,9.9],[110,147,8.3,9.1],
  [116.5,158.4,13.5,8.4],[117.1,171,25,8.4],[115.2,184,40.6,7.75],

    const pos=[],idx=[],uv=[],across=36,along=8;

function interpolate(keys,t){
  const i=Math.min(7,Math.floor(t/200)),j=(i+1)%8;
  const h=i===7?100:200,s=(t-i*200)/h;
  if(s===0)return keys[i];
  const before=(i+7)%8,after=(j+1)%8;
  const hp=before===7?100:200,hn=j===7?100:200;
  function slope(a,b){
    return a*b>0?2*a*b/(a+b):0;
  }
  return keys[i].map((a,k)=>{
    const b=keys[j][k],d=(b-a)/h;
    const v0=slope((a-keys[before][k])/hp,d),v1=slope(d,(keys[after][k]-b)/hn);
    return a+(b-a)*s*s*(3-2*s)+h*s*(1-s)*((1-s)*v0-s*v1);
  });
}

    farAngle+(1.90-farAngle)*turn);
  const [nx,ny,fx,fry]=key(rightEyeKeys),lean=clamp(-rx/8);
  rightNear(nx,ny,-.13-.10*lean,-.13-.20*lean,-.20+.12*turn);
  rightFar(fx,fry,-1.30-.045*lean,.01-.10*lean,-.16+.11*turn);
  leftMouth(...key(leftLipKeys));
  rightMouth(...key(rightLipKeys));

  const [wx,wy,roll]=key(writingKeys);
  const penMotion=delta(wx,wy,.16*wx);
  writing.bend(delta(lx*.84,ly*.86),penMotion,delta(.11*wx,wy*.18));
  writingHand.pose(penMotion,roll);

  const [tx,ty,handRoll]=key(touchKeys);
  const touch=delta(tx,ty,-tx*.62);
  reach.bend(delta(rx*.73,ry*.84),touch,delta(-tx*.16,ty*.17,1.5*lean));
  reachHand.pose(touch,handRoll);

  const hug=delta(lx*.73+rx*.41,ly*.39+ry*.17,.9*lean);
  farRight.bend(delta(rx*.83,ry*.9),hug,delta(0,-.55*lean));
  farHug.pose(hug,-.065*turn);
  const [restX,restY]=key(restKeys),onPage=delta(restX,restY);
  resting.bend(delta(lx*.83,ly*.84),onPage,delta(lx*.12,ly*.11));
  restHand.pose(onPage,.022*turn);

  renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
const characters=[left.root,right.root];
render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters,render,ready:true};
</script>
